statement: ∀ a : ℕ → ℝ, Tendsto a atTop (nhds 0) → Tendsto (fun n => Real.sqrt (a n)) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
intro a ha
have hc : Tendsto Real.sqrt (nhds (0 : ℝ)) (nhds (Real.sqrt 0)) :=
  Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto
simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_zero] using hc.comp ha
